preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in stdout.split('\n'))
postconditions.description: Each row in the output must have exactly m columns.
The output must contain exactly n rows.

postconditions.expression: all(cell.isupper() for row in stdout.split('\n') for cell in row)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the output must be an uppercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: all(all(cell == connected_region[0] for cell in connected_region) for connected_region in connected_regions)
postconditions.description: Each connected region of the same color must form a square.
The output must be the lexicographically minimum coloring that meets the described conditions.
